# c4 fixtures

- `basic.mmd`: mermaid-svg 0.7.0 sample (MIT), copied from
  `crates/nana-ui-runtime/tests/fixtures/mermaid/c4.mmd`.
- `context.mmd`, `container.mmd`, `component.mmd`, `dynamic.mmd`,
  `deployment.mmd`: examples from the Mermaid C4 documentation
  (https://mermaid.js.org/syntax/c4.html), MIT licensed, © Knut Sveidqvist
  and contributors.
- `cjk-styled.mmd`, `minimal.mmd`: written for this engine (CJK text,
  Db/Queue/external variants, author colours, layout config).
